summary: FC5030 是一款高性能 X 射线安全检查设备，采用先进的射线扫描技术对物品进行更加精确的检测。传感器迅速扫描穿过输送带的物品，通过 24 位真彩色图像显示进行仔细分类，高效排除潜在安全隐患。该产品探测精准及时，具备炸药与毒品辅助检查功能，为公共交通、重要场馆等环境的安全防卫体系提供坚实保障。其紧凑型设计与人性化操作界面，使其成为小型包裹安检的理想选择。
summary_en: The FC5030 is a high-performance X-ray security inspection system that utilizes advanced X-ray scanning technology for precise object detection. As items pass through the conveyor belt, high-speed sensors capture detailed data, presenting 24-bit true-color images for careful classification and effective elimination of potential security risks. Featuring accurate and timely detection capabilities, including assisted inspection for explosives and narcotics, this system provides a solid foundation for security defense in public transportation and critical venues. Its compact design and user-friendly interface make it the ideal choice for screening small parcels and baggage.
key_application: 应用领域：FC5030小型安检机；产品运用X射线对物品进行精确检测，排除安全隐患。探测精准及时，具备爆炸物/毒品辅助检查功能。
key_application_en: Precise X-ray scanning for small baggage and parcels; assisted detection for explosives and narcotics; high-resolution 21.5-inch LCD display; eco-friendly shielded design for radiation safety; 720 units/hour throughput.

parameters.分辨率: 线分辨力 Φ0.0787mm，空间分辨力 Φ0.8mm
parameters.X射线源: 底照式射线束，总电流 0.4~1.2mA (可调)
parameters.显示系统: 21.5寸高清液晶显示，24位真彩色图像
parameters.辐射安全: 泄露射线剂量率 0.01μGy/h (符合国内外健康标准)
parameters.系统功能: 爆炸物/毒品辅助检测、一键关机、图像增强、胶卷安全(ISO1600)

parameters_en.System Features: Assisted explosives/narcotics detection; One-key shutdown; Image enhancement

detail_html:
功能特点

  • 高精度X射线成像：24位真彩色显示，根据物质原子序数实时区分有机物、无机物及混合物。
  • 智能化辅助识别：内置炸药与毒品辅助检查算法，对可疑危险品进行高亮提醒。
  • 高清视觉体验：标配21.5寸超清显示器，支持边缘增强、高/低穿透显示及局部无级放大。
  • 环境友好型设计：专利铅帘保护膜工艺，防止接触性铅污染，保障乘客及员工健康。
  • 高效任务处理：支持每小时720件物品的高速通过，配备关机一键安全自锁系统。
  • 数据溯源管理：实时保存任意幅图像，支持前20幅图像回拉对比及USB批量导出。
  • Figure 1 X-Ray Baggage Scanner
detail_html_en:
Features

  • Advanced X-Ray Imaging: utilizes 24-bit true-color visualization to differentiate organic, inorganic, and metallic substances based on atomic density.
  • Intelligent Threat Detection: integrated software assists operators by highlighting potential explosives and narcotics within scanned packages.
  • High-Resolution Visuals: standard 21.5-inch LCD with features like edge enhancement, high/low penetration toggling, and 64x magnifying zoom.
  • Green Engineering: patented lead curtain protection films prevent direct contact with lead, ensuring a non-toxic environment for public use.
  • Operational Efficiency: supports a throughput of up to 720 units per hour with a simple one-key safety shutdown sequence.
  • Forensic Storage: enables real-time image saving with retrieval of the last 20 scans for on-the-spot comparison and data auditing.
